model.dataset: male CNS connectome v1.0 (Janelia FlyEM / Google Research / Cambridge, Cell 2026)
model.scope: brain (VNC excluded; VNC loading kept behind dataset.scope = 'cns')

filtering_steps.step: scope == 'brain': drop superclass vnc_* (VNC), ENS, and Traced bodies with no superclass

model.nt_sign_rule: GABA & glutamate -1 (Liu & Wilson 2013), ACh/DA/OA/5-HT +1 (Shiu et al. 2024); histamine -1 (HisCl, Hardie 1989 - pipeline decision)
model.engine_check_dataset: FlyWire v630 (127,400 neurons, 14,687,178 connections) - correctness check against Shiu et al. 2024's shipped output only

params.name: tau_syn
params.source: Juergensen et al. 2021 (via Shiu 2024; excitatory value applied to all synapses as in Shiu)

params.name: t_refractory
params.source: Lazar et al. 2021 / Kakaria & de Bivort 2017 (via Shiu 2024)

params.name: W_syn
params.source: Shiu et al. 2024 (free parameter, fit on FlyWire v630)

params.name: weight_scale
params.source: male CNS paper (Cell 2026) synapse-count calibration vs FlyWire; user-supplied, checked in stage 0

params.name: sign(histamine)
params.source: Hardie 1989 Nature 339:704 (HisCl); pipeline decision beyond Shiu 2024

params.name: sign(unknown NT)
params.source: no source: neurons with no NT prediction default to excitatory (count reported in manifest)

stage0_reproduction.title: Stage 0 - Engine check (FlyWire v630) + male CNS validation gate
stage0_reproduction.summary: engine passed; male CNS gate passed

stage1_noise.title: Stage 1 - Noise
stage1_noise.summary: 7 runs; isolated Gaussian model: sample s.d. of v within 5% of sigma for sigma <= 2 mV (threshold 7 mV above rest -> spikes negligible); Poisson mode runs with finite rates

stage2_criticality.title: Stage 2 - Criticality
stage2_criticality.summary: network=full; critical regime: NO; operating sigma 1.41 mV

stage3b_feasibility.title: Stage 3b - Is there a sparse odour code to encode a memory in?
stage3b_feasibility.summary: NO odour drive in the scan produced a sparse, transient Kenyon-cell response. Either the response fraction is far above the 5-10% measured in real flies, or the activity outlasts the odour because the network ignites. Th

stage3_plasticity.title: Stage 3 - Plasticity
stage3_plasticity.summary: unit test passes (depression only when Kenyon-cell activity precedes dopamine); the readout MBON responds to the calibration odour before pairing (> 5 spikes/s)
stage3_plasticity.gain_note: DEVIATION: every synaptic weight scaled to 0.6 of its published value, because at the published value the network has no sparse odour code to store a memory in (stage 3b). This is an uncited free parameter introduced by this project; see configs/stage3d_gain.yaml.

stage4_learning.title: Stage 4 - Learning
stage4_learning.summary: MBON11 response to odour A must fall relative to odour B from before to after conditioning: the paired difference of deltas (deltaA - deltaB) must be negative w
stage4_learning.gain_note: DEVIATION: every synaptic weight scaled to 0.6 of its published value, because at the published value there is no sparse odour code to store a memory in (stage 3b) and two odours leave indistinguishable ensembles (stage 3e).

stage5_sleep.title: Stage 5 - Sleep
stage5_sleep.summary: both conditions run to completion for every seed with the learned weights loaded, dFB neurons fire in the sleep condition and not in the wake condition, and KC
stage5_sleep.gain_note: DEVIATION: every synaptic weight scaled to 0.6 of its published value (stage 3b/3d).

stage6_replay.title: Stage 6 - Replay
stage6_replay.summary: In the real network 95% of all time bins clear the reactivation threshold. The ensemble is effectively on continuously, so 'reactivation events' are not discrete episodes and the template correlation mostly reflects how active those particular Kenyon cells are rather than whether a memory reappeared. Every comparison below must be read with that in mind. No evidence of memory replay: the odour-A ensemble did not reactivate above chance during simulated sleep. Comparisons that did not show the predicted effect: A_vs_B_sleep, sleep_vs_wake_A. The learned weights did increase reactivation relative to the identical run with unlearned weights (difference +0.14072, 95% CI [+0.10463, +0.17492]).
stage6_replay.gain_note: DEVIATION: every synaptic weight scaled to 0.6 of its published value, because at the published value the network has neither a sparse odour code nor a quiet background (stages 2 and 3b). This is an uncited free parameter introduced by this project.
